purpose: Add the missing same-target Pollard-rho control on the quotient by negation and Koblitz Frobenius.
construction: A 16-way r-adding walk canonicalizes every state over {plus or minus Frobenius^k : 0 <= k < n}. When canonicalization multiplies a point by plus or minus lambda^k, it multiplies both tracked coefficients by the same public scalar modulo the subgroup order.
collision_equation: Equal canonical points give (a1-a2)P=(b2-b1)Q; invert the denominator modulo the prime subgroup order and verify the candidate against Q.
controls: Every returned scalar must reproduce the public target
Generic rho from stage 2 remains the non-quotient control
Report quotient iterations and actual group additions separately because canonicalization also performs field squarings
claim_boundary: Two degree-9 controls can validate implementation and full-cost reporting. They cannot establish asymptotic scaling, cryptographic-size superiority, or SOTA.
